title: KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡~KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope
focus: 地底低地動站址、20 K 藍寶石測試質量、低溫懸吊導熱、共振邊帶擷取干涉儀與冷凝污染管理~Low-seismic underground siting, 20 K sapphire test masses, cryogenic suspension heat extraction, resonant-sideband-extraction optics and cryo-contamination control
summary: 以神岡礦山地下超過 200 m 的 KAGRA 為對象，理解它如何用地底低地動與把 22.8 kg 藍寶石測試質量冷到約 20 K 兩個策略壓低雜訊，再把 3 km Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與訊號擷取、藍寶石光學、低溫懸吊導熱、熱連結振動、網路觀測與冷凝污染整合成可交接的觀測站工程。~Taking KAGRA, more than 200 m underground in the Kamioka mine, see how it lowers noise with two strategies, a quiet underground site and 22.8 kg sapphire test masses cooled to about 20 K, then integrate 3 km Fabry–Pérot arms with signal extraction, sapphire optics, cryogenic heat extraction, heat-link vibration, network observing and cryo-contamination into a transferable observatory engineering record.

units.anchor: 3 km 臂與神岡地下站址~3 km arms and the Kamioka underground site
units.title: 應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注~Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet
units.mechanism: 重力波通過時以應變 h = ΔL/L 拉伸與壓縮兩條垂直的臂，KAGRA 以兩條 3 km 臂的雷射干涉儀量測臂長差。地面干涉儀的低頻端主要受地動與重力梯度（牛頓）雜訊限制，中頻受鏡面與懸吊的熱雜訊限制。KAGRA 的兩個設計選擇正對應這兩項：把整座干涉儀建在岐阜縣神岡礦山岩層下超過 200 m 處，使 10 Hz 以上的地動比地面低約兩個數量級；並把測試質量與最末級懸吊冷到約 20 K，使熱雜訊隨溫度下降。這讓 KAGRA 成為第一座同時採用地底與低溫的公里級重力波望遠鏡，也帶來地下水、低溫振動與冷凝污染等新的工程問題。~A passing gravitational wave stretches and squeezes two perpendicular arms with strain h = ΔL/L, and KAGRA measures the arm-length difference with a laser interferometer having two 3 km arms. Ground-based interferometers are limited at low frequency by ground motion and gravity-gradient (Newtonian) noise and at mid frequency by thermal noise of mirrors and suspensions. KAGRA's two design choices target exactly these: the whole interferometer sits more than 200 m under the rock of the Kamioka mine in Gifu Prefecture, where ground motion above 10 Hz is about two orders of magnitude lower than at the surface, and the test masses and final suspension stages are cooled to about 20 K so that thermal noise falls with temperature. This made KAGRA the first kilometre-scale detector to be both underground and cryogenic, and it introduced new engineering problems such as groundwater, cryogenic vibration and cryo-contamination.
units.model: h = 1×10⁻²¹（教學假設）時 ΔL = h·L = 1×10⁻²¹ × 3000 m = 3×10⁻¹⁸ m。布朗熱雜訊振幅約 ∝ √(T·φ)，損耗角不變時由 300 K 冷到 20 K 約降為 1/√15 ≈ 1/3.9；地下地動降低約 100 倍，相當於隔振需求少了 40 dB。~For h = 1×10⁻²¹ (teaching assumption) ΔL = h·L = 1×10⁻²¹ × 3000 m = 3×10⁻¹⁸ m. Brownian thermal-noise amplitude scales roughly as √(T·φ), so cooling from 300 K to 20 K at fixed loss angle lowers it by 1/√15 ≈ 1/3.9; the roughly 100-fold quieter underground ground motion is worth 40 dB of isolation.
units.verify: 以寬頻地震儀同時記錄坑道內與地表的三軸地動，計算 1 到 100 Hz 的振幅譜密度比；以測試質量溫度計的讀值與擺的品質因子量測，估算熱雜訊並在干涉儀雜訊預算中與實測靈敏度曲線比對，確認哪一頻段由哪一項主導。~Record three-axis ground motion simultaneously in the tunnel and at the surface with broadband seismometers and compute the amplitude-spectral-density ratio from 1 to 100 Hz; estimate thermal noise from test-mass thermometry and measured pendulum quality factors, and compare it in the interferometer noise budget with the measured sensitivity curve to see which term dominates each band.
units.failure: 若只把地底當成安靜的地方，而忽略岩體內的地下水與高濕度，電子設備腐蝕、局部積水與泵浦振動會成為新的雜訊與停機來源；若冷卻不到設計溫度，熱雜訊收益會遠低於預期，靈敏度停在室溫干涉儀的水準。~Treating the underground merely as a quiet place while ignoring groundwater and high humidity in the rock lets corrosion of electronics, local flooding and pump vibration become new noise and downtime sources; if the test masses never reach design temperature, the thermal-noise gain is far smaller than planned and sensitivity stays at room-temperature levels.
units.misconception: 只要放到地底，重力波干涉儀的所有雜訊都會大幅下降。~Putting an interferometer underground lowers all of its noise sources dramatically.

units.anchor: 臂腔、功率回收與訊號回收鏡~Arm cavities, power and signal recycling
units.title: Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取~Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction
units.mechanism: KAGRA 在每條臂放入 Fabry–Pérot 共振腔，讓光在臂內往返數百次以放大臂長變化造成的相位；設計精細度上限約 1550，室溫實測約 1300 到 1400。分光鏡前的功率回收鏡把回到雷射方向的光再送回干涉儀，實測回收增益約 11 到 12；暗埠的訊號回收鏡則形成共振邊帶擷取（RSE）結構，讓高精細度臂腔儲存大功率的同時，把重力波訊號邊帶擷取出來，加寬偵測頻寬。高精細度的另一個用意是讓分光鏡與輸入測試質量基板內的功率較低，減少低溫鏡面的吸熱。~KAGRA places a Fabry–Pérot cavity in each arm so that light makes hundreds of round trips and amplifies the phase produced by an arm-length change; the design finesse is capped near 1550, with about 1300 to 1400 measured at room temperature. A power-recycling mirror before the beam splitter sends light heading back to the laser into the interferometer again, with a measured recycling gain of about 11 to 12, and a signal-recycling mirror at the dark port forms a resonant-sideband-extraction (RSE) configuration that lets high-finesse arms store large power while extracting the gravitational-wave sidebands and widening the detection band. High finesse also keeps the power inside the beam splitter and input test-mass substrates low, reducing heating of the cryogenic mirrors.
units.model: 臂腔增益 ≈ 2F/π：F = 1550 時約 987，設計分光鏡功率 674 W 時每臂約 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW。腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) ≈ 3×10⁸/(4×3000×1550) ≈ 16 Hz；RSE 的等效頻寬約 f_p·(1 + r_s)/(1 − r_s)：設計振幅反射率 r_s = 0.92 時約 390 Hz，安裝的 70% 功率反射（r_s ≈ 0.84）時約 180 Hz。~Arm gain ≈ 2F/π: about 987 for F = 1550, so the design 674 W at the beam splitter gives about 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW per arm. The cavity pole is f_p = c/(4LF) ≈ 3×10⁸/(4×3000×1550) ≈ 16 Hz; RSE widens the bandwidth to about f_p·(1 + r_s)/(1 − r_s), about 390 Hz for the design amplitude reflectivity r_s = 0.92 and about 180 Hz for the installed 70% power reflectivity (r_s ≈ 0.84).
units.verify: 以掃頻或鎖定後的透射光衰減時間量測臂腔精細度；以功率回收腔鎖定前後的分光鏡處功率比得到回收增益；注入已知的差模長度調變並量測轉移函數，擬合出腔極點與訊號回收後的頻寬，再與設計值比較。~Measure arm finesse from cavity scans or the ring-down of transmitted light; obtain the recycling gain from the ratio of beam-splitter power with and without the power-recycling cavity locked; inject a known differential length modulation, measure the transfer function and fit the cavity pole and the signal-recycled bandwidth for comparison with design.
units.failure: 鏡面低溫後若表面吸附分子層使損耗增加，精細度與回收增益同時下降，臂內功率與靈敏度一起變差；訊號回收鏡反射率或失諧相位與設計不符時，偵測頻寬偏移，雜訊預算中的散粒雜訊曲線與實測對不上。~If molecular layers adsorb on the cold mirror surfaces and raise losses, finesse and recycling gain fall together, dragging arm power and sensitivity down; if the signal-recycling reflectivity or detuning phase departs from design, the detection band shifts and the shot-noise curve in the noise budget no longer matches measurement.
units.misconception: 臂腔精細度越高，干涉儀在所有頻率都越靈敏。~Higher arm finesse makes the interferometer more sensitive at every frequency.

units.anchor: c 軸藍寶石測試質量~c-axis sapphire test mass
units.title: 藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸~Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size
units.mechanism: KAGRA 的測試質量是直徑 22 cm、厚 15 cm、質量 22.8 kg 的 c 軸藍寶石，前表面曲率半徑約 1.9 km。選藍寶石而非熔融石英，是因為石英在低溫下機械損耗反而上升，而藍寶石在 20 K 附近熱導率極高、機械品質因子大且熱膨脹趨近於零，熱彈性雜訊與熱透鏡效應都隨之消失。代價是藍寶石為單軸晶體，光軸必須沿 c 軸以避免雙折射；晶體內吸收分布不均、大尺寸晶體取得困難，拋光與鍍膜也比石英難。鏡面上的光束越大，平均掉的鍍膜熱雜訊越多，但需要確保邊緣繞射損耗可忽略。~KAGRA's test masses are c-axis sapphire, 22 cm in diameter, 15 cm thick and 22.8 kg, with a front-surface radius of curvature of about 1.9 km. Sapphire was chosen over fused silica because silica's mechanical loss rises at low temperature, whereas sapphire near 20 K has very high thermal conductivity, a high mechanical quality factor and a thermal expansion that tends to zero, so thermoelastic noise and thermal lensing both vanish. The price is that sapphire is uniaxial, so the beam must travel along the c-axis to avoid birefringence; absorption is inhomogeneous within the crystal, large crystals are hard to obtain, and polishing and coating are harder than for silica. A larger beam on the mirror averages away more coating thermal noise, provided edge diffraction loss stays negligible.
units.model: 質量 m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg。對稱腔 L = 3000 m、R = 1900 m 時 g = 1 − L/R ≈ −0.579，鏡面光束半徑 w² = (λL/π)/√(1 − g²) 給出 λ = 1064 nm 時 w ≈ 35 mm；22 cm 鏡面的邊緣截斷損耗 exp(−2a²/w²) ≈ 4×10⁻⁹，可忽略。~Mass m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg. For a symmetric cavity with L = 3000 m and R = 1900 m, g = 1 − L/R ≈ −0.579, and the mirror beam radius from w² = (λL/π)/√(1 − g²) at λ = 1064 nm is about 35 mm; the clipping loss of a 22 cm mirror, exp(−2a²/w²), is about 4×10⁻⁹ and negligible.
units.verify: 以偏振量測檢查基板沿光軸的雙折射與 c 軸對準誤差；以光熱共光路干涉法掃描基板的吸收分布圖；以干涉儀量測鍍膜後的面形與曲率半徑，並把實測曲率代入腔模型，預測光束半徑與高階模態間距，與腔掃描時的模態頻率比對。~Check birefringence along the beam axis and c-axis alignment error with polarimetry; map substrate absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry; measure post-coating figure and radius of curvature interferometrically, feed the measured curvature into the cavity model to predict beam radius and higher-order-mode spacing, and compare with mode frequencies seen in cavity scans.
units.failure: 若晶體 c 軸與光軸偏差數度，穿過輸入測試質量的光產生偏振轉換，部分功率變成無法共振的偏振，回收增益下降並增加暗埠雜光；吸收熱點則在低溫下集中加熱，使鏡面局部溫度偏高。~If the crystal c-axis is a few degrees off the beam axis, light passing through the input test mass undergoes polarisation conversion, part of the power ends up in a non-resonant polarisation, recycling gain falls and dark-port stray light grows; absorption hot spots concentrate heating and leave the mirror locally warmer at cryogenic temperature.
units.misconception: 熔融石英在室溫表現最好，所以低溫下也一定是最佳鏡材。~Fused silica is best at room temperature, so it must also be best when cold.

units.anchor: 低溫懸吊與藍寶石纖維~Cryopayload and sapphire fibres
units.title: 低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間~Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time
units.mechanism: 測試質量在真空中懸吊，熱只能經由懸吊纖維傳導或輻射散失；而在 20 K 附近輻射散熱極弱，所以吸收的雷射熱必須沿四根長 35 cm、粗 1.6 mm 的藍寶石纖維傳到上一級質量，再經純鋁熱連結傳到低溫恆溫器。每座恆溫器有四台二級脈衝管冷凍機，全站共 16 台，並以 8 K 內層與 80 K 外層輻射屏蔽包圍；長約 5 m 的導管屏蔽阻擋室溫熱輻射沿光路進入。纖維必須同時夠細以降低懸吊熱雜訊、夠粗以帶走熱，形成直接的設計取捨。2018 年首次低溫運轉時，一面端測試質量約 30 天降到 18 K。~The test mass hangs in vacuum and can lose heat only by conduction along its suspension fibres or by radiation, and radiation is very weak near 20 K, so absorbed laser heat must flow through four sapphire fibres 35 cm long and 1.6 mm thick to the stage above, then through pure-aluminium heat links to the cryostat. Each cryostat has four two-stage pulse-tube cryocoolers, 16 in all, with inner 8 K and outer 80 K radiation shields, and duct shields about 5 m long stop room-temperature radiation from entering along the beam path. The fibres must be thin to reduce suspension thermal noise yet thick enough to carry the heat, a direct design trade-off. In the first cryogenic operation in 2018, an end test mass took about 30 days to reach 18 K.
units.model: 四根纖維的熱導 G = 4kA/L：假設細纖維在 20 K 的熱導率 k ≈ 2000 W/(m·K)，A = π(0.8 mm)² ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁶ m²，L = 0.35 m，G ≈ 0.046 W/K。若鏡面吸收 0.42 W，鏡面比上一級高 ΔT = Q/G ≈ 9 K；上一級 13 K 時鏡面約 22 K，正是設計溫度上限。~The conductance of four fibres is G = 4kA/L: assuming k ≈ 2000 W/(m·K) for thin fibres at 20 K, A = π(0.8 mm)² ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁶ m² and L = 0.35 m, G ≈ 0.046 W/K. If the mirror absorbs 0.42 W, it runs ΔT = Q/G ≈ 9 K warmer than the stage above; with that stage at 13 K the mirror sits near 22 K, right at the design limit.
units.verify: 在各級質量與屏蔽上裝校正過的低溫溫度計，記錄冷卻曲線並以熱容與熱導模型擬合；在穩態下改變臂內功率，量測鏡面與上一級的溫差對吸收功率的斜率，反推纖維與接合面的實際熱導，再與設計值比較。~Mount calibrated cryogenic thermometers on every stage and shield, record the cool-down curves and fit them with heat-capacity and conductance models; in steady state vary arm power and measure the slope of the mirror-to-stage temperature difference versus absorbed power to back out the real conductance of fibres and joints, then compare with design.
units.failure: 纖維與鏡體接合面（例如接合鉤）熱阻偏大時，同樣吸收功率下鏡面溫度明顯升高，熱雜訊收益消失，只能降低輸入功率而犧牲高頻散粒雜訊；熱連結若太硬，又會把恆溫器振動直接帶進鏡面。~If the joint between fibre and mirror body has excess thermal resistance, the same absorbed power raises the mirror temperature markedly, the thermal-noise gain disappears and input power must be cut at the expense of high-frequency shot noise; heat links that are too stiff carry cryostat vibration straight into the mirror.
units.misconception: 鏡面在真空中冷卻，只要冷凍機功率夠大就能維持低溫。~A mirror in vacuum stays cold as long as the cryocoolers are powerful enough.

units.anchor: 吸收熱預算與臂內功率~Absorption heat budget and arm power
units.title: 低溫鏡面的吸收熱預算與功率上限~Absorption heat budget and the power ceiling of cryogenic mirrors
units.mechanism: 室溫干涉儀可以不斷提高雷射功率來壓低散粒雜訊，再以熱補償系統處理熱透鏡；KAGRA 則被低溫限制：鏡面吸收的每一瓦都必須經由細纖維帶走，因此吸收熱預算直接決定可用的臂內功率。熱源有兩部分：輸入測試質量的基板吸收（光以回收腔功率穿過 15 cm 藍寶石）與每面鏡的鍍膜吸收（以臂內數百 kW 的功率計算）。由於藍寶石在低溫下的折射率溫度係數與膨脹極小，熱透鏡幾乎不存在，問題完全變成熱量是否送得出去。~A room-temperature interferometer can keep raising laser power to suppress shot noise and treat thermal lensing with a compensation system, but KAGRA is bounded by cryogenics: every watt absorbed by a mirror must leave through thin fibres, so the absorption heat budget sets the usable arm power. There are two heat sources: substrate absorption in the input test mass, where light crosses 15 cm of sapphire at the recycling-cavity power, and coating absorption on every mirror at the arm power of hundreds of kilowatts. Because sapphire's thermo-optic coefficient and expansion are tiny when cold, thermal lensing is almost absent and the problem becomes purely whether the heat can be extracted.
units.model: 假設基板吸收 50 ppm/cm、鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm：基板熱 = 337 W × 50×10⁻⁶/cm × 15 cm ≈ 0.25 W，鍍膜熱 = 333 kW × 0.5×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.17 W，合計約 0.42 W。若基板吸收不均使局部達 100 ppm/cm，合計約 0.67 W，在 G ≈ 0.046 W/K 時溫差升到約 15 K；要守住 0.42 W，分光鏡功率需降到約 674 × 0.62 ≈ 420 W。~Assume 50 ppm/cm substrate and 0.5 ppm coating absorption: substrate heat = 337 W × 50×10⁻⁶/cm × 15 cm ≈ 0.25 W and coating heat = 333 kW × 0.5×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.17 W, about 0.42 W in total. If inhomogeneous sapphire reaches 100 ppm/cm the total is about 0.67 W and, with G ≈ 0.046 W/K, the temperature difference rises to about 15 K; holding 0.42 W requires cutting beam-splitter power to about 674 × 0.62 ≈ 420 W.
units.verify: 安裝前以光熱法量測基板吸收分布並計算沿光束路徑的加權平均；運轉中逐步提高輸入功率，同時記錄鏡面溫度、臂內功率與回收增益，擬合溫升對臂內功率的斜率，分離基板與鍍膜兩項吸收，作為設定最大輸入功率的依據。~Before installation map substrate absorption photothermally and compute the beam-weighted average along the path; in operation raise input power step by step while logging mirror temperature, arm power and recycling gain, and fit the temperature rise versus arm power to separate substrate and coating absorption as the basis for the maximum input power.
units.failure: 若只用晶體平均吸收值估熱，而光束恰好穿過吸收熱點，實際溫度高於預期，熱雜訊與纖維熱導同時惡化，干涉儀在升功率途中失鎖或必須退回低功率運轉。~Estimating heat from a crystal-average absorption while the beam happens to cross an absorption hot spot leaves the real temperature higher than expected, worsening thermal noise and fibre conductance together, so the interferometer loses lock during power-up or must retreat to low power.
units.misconception: 低溫干涉儀和室溫干涉儀一樣，提高雷射功率就一定提升靈敏度。~Like a room-temperature detector, a cryogenic interferometer always gains sensitivity from more laser power.

units.anchor: Type-A 隔振塔與熱連結~Type-A tower and heat links
units.title: 隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算~Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget
units.mechanism: KAGRA 的測試質量掛在高 13.5 m 的 Type-A 系統下：上方為倒立擺與多級幾何反彈簧濾波器組成的室溫隔振鏈，下方接入低溫恆溫器內的低溫懸吊；分光鏡與訊號回收鏡使用較短的 Type-B 系統，功率回收鏡使用 Type-Bp。低溫設計的特殊風險是熱連結：它必須接到懸吊鏈中才能導熱，等於在精心設計的隔振鏈旁開了一條振動捷徑，把冷凍機與屏蔽的振動帶入鏡面。因此熱連結要做得非常柔軟，並接在已被隔振的中間級，而不是直接接在鏡體附近。地下的低地動讓這條預算可行，但不會自動解決熱連結問題。~KAGRA's test masses hang below the 13.5 m Type-A system: an inverted pendulum and multiple geometric-anti-spring filters form a room-temperature isolation chain above, which connects to the cryogenic payload inside the cryostat; the beam splitter and signal-recycling mirror use the shorter Type-B system and the power-recycling mirrors Type-Bp. The special cryogenic risk is the heat link: it must attach to the suspension chain to carry heat, which opens a vibration shortcut beside a carefully designed isolation chain and brings cryocooler and shield vibration into the mirror. The links must therefore be extremely soft and attached at already-isolated intermediate stages rather than near the mirror. Low underground ground motion makes the budget feasible but does not solve the heat-link problem by itself.
units.model: 假設地下 10 Hz 地動 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz、隔振鏈 5 級各共振 0.5 Hz，傳遞 ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³，鏡面約 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz。若 h = 1×10⁻²²/√Hz，單面鏡容許 h·L/2 = 1.5×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz。但屏蔽振動 1×10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 若經熱連結只過兩級 1 Hz 濾波，殘餘 (1/10)⁴ × 10⁻⁹ = 1×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz，超標近百萬倍。~Assume 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz of underground motion at 10 Hz and a 5-stage chain with 0.5 Hz resonances: transmission ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³ leaves about 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz at the mirror. For h = 1×10⁻²²/√Hz a single mirror may move h·L/2 = 1.5×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz. Yet shield vibration of 1×10⁻⁹ m/√Hz reaching the mirror through a heat link past only two 1 Hz stages leaves (1/10)⁴ × 10⁻⁹ = 1×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz, nearly a million times too much.
units.verify: 在冷凍機運轉與暫停的條件下分別量測恆溫器屏蔽與懸吊各級的加速度譜，比較差值以找出經熱連結進入的振動；以注入式量測（在屏蔽上施加已知振動）求得屏蔽到鏡面的耦合轉移函數，並把結果放進干涉儀雜訊預算。~Measure acceleration spectra of cryostat shields and each suspension stage with the cryocoolers running and paused, and compare to isolate vibration entering through the heat links; inject known vibration on the shield to measure the shield-to-mirror coupling transfer function and place the result in the interferometer noise budget.
units.failure: 熱連結在冷卻收縮後變緊或碰觸屏蔽，會在靈敏度曲線上出現與冷凍機頻率及其諧波相關的尖峰與寬帶雜訊；若誤以為來自地動而加強隔振鏈，問題不會消失。~A heat link that tightens after thermal contraction or touches a shield produces peaks and broadband noise at the cryocooler frequency and its harmonics in the sensitivity curve; treating it as ground motion and strengthening the isolation chain does not make it go away.
units.misconception: 隔振鏈夠長，就不必在意任何連到鏡子的其他連線。~A long enough isolation chain makes other connections to the mirror irrelevant.

units.title: 網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位~Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation
units.mechanism: 單一干涉儀無法精確判斷重力波來源方向，多座相距數千公里的干涉儀以到達時間差、振幅比與相位比進行三角定位。KAGRA 在 2020 年 2 月開始首次觀測，同年 4 月與 GEO600 聯合觀測時中子星雙星靈敏距離約 1 Mpc；2023 年 5 月加入第四輪觀測 O4，2024 年 1 月能登半島地震後進行設施檢查與修復，2025 年 6 月與 LIGO、Virgo 協調恢復 O4，直到 2025 年 11 月 O4 完成。KAGRA 的方位與緯度不同，天線響應圖案與其他偵測器互補，即使靈敏距離較短，也能改善網路的定位與偏振量測。~A single interferometer cannot locate a gravitational-wave source precisely, so detectors thousands of kilometres apart triangulate using arrival-time differences, amplitude ratios and phase ratios. KAGRA began its first observing run in February 2020 and reached a binary-neutron-star range of about 1 Mpc during joint observation with GEO600 that April; it joined the fourth observing run O4 in May 2023, underwent facility inspection and repair after the January 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake, resumed O4 in coordination with LIGO and Virgo in June 2025, and remained until O4 ended in November 2025. Its different orientation and latitude give an antenna pattern that complements the other detectors, improving network localisation and polarisation measurement even with a shorter range.
units.model: 偵測體積 ∝ 靈敏距離³：由 1 Mpc 提升到 10 Mpc，體積增加 10³ = 1000 倍。若另一偵測器的距離為 160 Mpc（假設），10 Mpc 的 KAGRA 偵測體積只有 (10/160)³ ≈ 2.4×10⁻⁴，所以 KAGRA 早期的主要貢獻是為其他偵測器觸發的事件提供額外基線，而非獨立發現事件。~Detection volume scales as range³: going from 1 Mpc to 10 Mpc increases it 10³ = 1000 times. If another detector has a 160 Mpc range (assumption), a 10 Mpc KAGRA covers only (10/160)³ ≈ 2.4×10⁻⁴ of its volume, so KAGRA's early contribution is an extra baseline for events triggered by other detectors rather than independent discoveries.
units.verify: 以光子校正器（1047 nm 雷射推動測試質量）產生已知位移，建立應變校正與時間戳準確度；以 GPS 同步的時間系統比對各站資料，並以網路分析中注入的模擬訊號檢查定位面積隨 KAGRA 加入與否的變化。~Generate known displacements with the photon calibrator, a 1047 nm laser pushing the test mass, to establish strain calibration and timestamp accuracy; compare data across sites with GPS-synchronised timing, and check how localisation area changes with and without KAGRA using simulated signals injected into network analysis.
units.failure: 若時間戳或校正相位有毫秒級或數度的系統誤差，KAGRA 的資料在三角定位中會把天區推向錯誤位置，反而降低網路定位品質；觀測期間若鎖定時間比例低，網路中同時運轉的偵測器組合減少。~A millisecond timestamp error or a few degrees of calibration phase error makes KAGRA data push the sky location to the wrong place in triangulation, degrading rather than improving network localisation; a low lock duty factor during a run reduces the number of times all detectors observe together.
units.misconception: 靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。~A detector with a shorter range adds nothing to network observing.

units.anchor: 冷鏡面分子吸附與回溫~Cold-mirror adsorption and warm-up
units.title: 地下低溫營運：冷凝污染、地震恢復與交接~Underground cryogenic operation: cryo-contamination, earthquake recovery and handoff
units.mechanism: 低溫鏡面本身就是一個冷凝泵：真空中殘留的水分子一碰到 20 K 的鏡面就會吸附，逐漸形成分子層，改變鍍膜的反射率並增加吸收與散射。KAGRA 以長導管屏蔽限制殘氣進入的立體角，但吸附無法完全避免，必要時需回溫讓分子脫附，而每次回溫與再冷卻都要數週時間。地下設施另有地下水、濕度與地震等風險，2024 年能登半島地震後就需要逐項檢查懸吊、真空與光學對準。交接紀錄應包含各鏡面溫度歷史、精細度與回收增益趨勢、冷凍機與真空狀態，以及每次回溫的原因與結果。~A cryogenic mirror is itself a cryopump: residual water molecules in the vacuum that strike the 20 K surface stick and slowly build a molecular layer that changes coating reflectance and adds absorption and scatter. KAGRA uses long duct shields to restrict the solid angle through which residual gas can arrive, but adsorption cannot be avoided completely, so the mirrors must sometimes be warmed to desorb the layer, and every warm-up and re-cooling takes weeks. The underground facility also faces groundwater, humidity and earthquakes; after the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake, suspensions, vacuum and optical alignment all had to be checked item by item. The handoff record should hold each mirror's temperature history, finesse and recycling-gain trends, cryocooler and vacuum status, and the reason and outcome of every warm-up.
units.model: 水分子撞擊率 Φ = P/√(2πmkT)：P = 1×10⁻⁷ Pa、T = 300 K、m = 18 u 時 Φ ≈ 3.6×10¹⁵ m⁻²s⁻¹。以冰密度 930 kg/m³ 換算，無遮蔽時成長約 1.2×10⁻¹³ m/s ≈ 10 nm/天；導管屏蔽若把可見立體角降為 10⁻³（假設），約 3.6 nm/年。~The water impingement rate is Φ = P/√(2πmkT): for P = 1×10⁻⁷ Pa, T = 300 K and m = 18 u, Φ ≈ 3.6×10¹⁵ m⁻²s⁻¹. Converting with an ice density of 930 kg/m³, an unshielded mirror grows a layer at about 1.2×10⁻¹³ m/s ≈ 10 nm per day; duct shields that cut the visible solid angle to 10⁻³ (assumption) bring it to about 3.6 nm per year.
units.verify: 以殘氣分析儀監測各真空段的水分壓；定期量測臂腔精細度與鏡面反射率的變化趨勢，並以鏡面散射光相機追蹤散射增加；回溫後重測精細度，確認損耗是否回到基準，以此區分可逆的分子吸附與不可逆的鍍膜損傷。~Monitor water partial pressure in each vacuum section with residual-gas analysers; track trends of arm finesse and mirror reflectance periodically and follow scatter growth with mirror-scatter cameras; after a warm-up remeasure finesse to see whether losses return to baseline, separating reversible adsorption from irreversible coating damage.
units.failure: 若冷卻前真空烘烤不足或導管屏蔽溫度過高，分子層在數週內就讓精細度明顯下降，被誤判為鍍膜劣化而考慮更換鏡面；地震後若只檢查真空而未重新量測懸吊共振頻率與對準，偵測器會帶著隱藏的摩擦或碰觸問題重新加入觀測。~If vacuum bake-out before cooling is insufficient or duct shields run too warm, a molecular layer visibly lowers finesse within weeks and may be misjudged as coating degradation that calls for mirror replacement; after an earthquake, checking only the vacuum without remeasuring suspension resonances and alignment lets the detector rejoin observation with hidden rubbing or contact problems.
units.misconception: 高真空中的低溫鏡面不會被任何氣體污染。~A cryogenic mirror in high vacuum cannot be contaminated by any gas.

example: 低溫功率預算練習：設計分光鏡功率 674 W、臂腔精細度 1550，臂內功率 ≈ 674/2 × 2×1550/π ≈ 333 kW。假設輸入測試質量基板吸收 50 ppm/cm、厚 15 cm，鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm，吸收熱 ≈ 337 × 7.5×10⁻⁴ + 333,000 × 5×10⁻⁷ ≈ 0.25 + 0.17 = 0.42 W。四根纖維熱導 G = 4kA/L，取 k = 2000 W/(m·K)、A = 2.0×10⁻⁶ m²、L = 0.35 m，G ≈ 0.046 W/K，溫差 ≈ 9.1 K；上一級 13 K 時鏡面約 22 K。熱雜訊振幅相對室溫降為 √(22/300) ≈ 0.27。若吸收倍增到 100 ppm/cm，熱量 0.67 W、溫差 14.6 K、鏡面約 27.6 K，需把分光鏡功率降到約 420 W 才能守住 22 K，臂內功率變為約 207 kW，散粒雜訊振幅約增為 √(333/207) ≈ 1.27 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表 KAGRA 的實際運轉參數。~Cryogenic power-budget exercise: with the design 674 W at the beam splitter and finesse 1550, arm power ≈ 674/2 × 2×1550/π ≈ 333 kW. Assuming 50 ppm/cm absorption in the 15 cm input test-mass substrate and 0.5 ppm coating absorption, absorbed heat ≈ 337 × 7.5×10⁻⁴ + 333,000 × 5×10⁻⁷ ≈ 0.25 + 0.17 = 0.42 W. The four-fibre conductance G = 4kA/L with k = 2000 W/(m·K), A = 2.0×10⁻⁶ m² and L = 0.35 m is G ≈ 0.046 W/K, giving a temperature difference of about 9.1 K, so with the stage above at 13 K the mirror sits near 22 K. Thermal-noise amplitude relative to room temperature drops to √(22/300) ≈ 0.27. If absorption doubles to 100 ppm/cm, the heat is 0.67 W, the difference 14.6 K and the mirror about 27.6 K; holding 22 K requires cutting beam-splitter power to about 420 W, arm power to about 207 kW, and shot-noise amplitude rises by about √(333/207) ≈ 1.27. Values are teaching assumptions, not KAGRA operating parameters.
history: KAGRA 計畫於 2010 年啟動，2012 年 1 月在神岡舉行動工典禮，2014 年 3 月完成坑道開挖。2016 年 3 月以室溫熔融石英鏡進行簡易麥克森運轉（iKAGRA），2018 年 4 月完成首次低溫運轉測試，2019 年完成基線設計配置。2020 年 2 月開始首次觀測並於同年 4 月與 GEO600 聯合觀測，之後參與 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 的第四輪觀測，在能登半島地震後修復並於 2025 年恢復觀測。~The KAGRA project started in 2010, held its ground-breaking ceremony at Kamioka in January 2012 and completed tunnel excavation in March 2014. In March 2016 it ran a simple room-temperature Michelson with fused-silica mirrors (iKAGRA), in April 2018 it completed its first cryogenic test operation, and in 2019 it finished installation of the baseline design. It began observing in February 2020, observed jointly with GEO600 that April, then took part in the fourth LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA observing run, recovering from the Noto Peninsula earthquake and resuming observation in 2025.
